title: Is ChatGPT eating Google's lunch?
hook: 午休時間，Google 打開便當，發現少了一格。
bridge: 那個「五分之一」是怎麼算出來的？看起來像是在信封背面隨手寫的。
p: For two decades, search was Google's lunch, and nobody else got a bite. On November 3, OpenAI's Adam Fry, who leads ChatGPT's consumer product, told Big Technology that ChatGPT now handles roughly one-fifth as many search-like queries as Google. If that holds, a chatbot has started {0}.

Read the fine print, though. OpenAI counts a search every time a question sends ChatGPT to the web, and Fry didn't say which Google figure he used. Ahrefs, with a different definition, put the share near 12 percent in February. Until OpenAI shows its math, one-fifth is closer to a {1} estimate than an audited statistic.

words.def: to take business or market share away from a competitor
words.mn: 午休時間，Google 打開便當，發現 ChatGPT 已經坐在旁邊夾走了五格裡的一格。便當被吃掉，就是生意被搶走。
words.ex: Low-cost rivals are eating our lunch in the mid-range segment.
words.exZh: 低價對手正在中階市場搶走我們的生意。

words.def: rough and quick, worked out without detailed data
words.mn: 手邊沒有報表，只好抓起一個信封翻到背面，用筆草草寫下「≈ 1/5 ?」。寫在信封背面的數字，就是還沒驗證的粗估。
words.ex: A back-of-the-envelope calculation puts the market at around $2 billion.
words.exZh: 粗略估算，這個市場大約 20 億美元。

quiz.q: The new entrant's free tier is ___. Incumbents lost 30% of signups in one quarter.
quiz.why: eat someone's lunch 是搶走生意或市佔。steal someone's thunder 是搶風頭，rain on someone's parade 是掃興。

quiz.q: I haven't seen the real data. This is only a ___ calculation.
quiz.why: back-of-the-envelope 專指粗略的計算。off-the-cuff 是即興發言，under-the-table 是檯面下的交易。
